question: Aryan has to reach Ahmedabad which is 977 km away in 11 hours. His starting speed for 4 hours was 39 km/hr. For the next 140 km his speed was 35 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Ahmedabad in the decided time of 11 hours?
solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 977 km

Total time = 11 hours

Speed for first 4 hours = 39 km/hr

Distance for next part = 140 km

Speed for next part = 35 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered in first 4 hours = 3
